name: @caisson/license-verify
description: Offline license-token verification: a signed wire codec (PREFIX-TIER-base64url(payload+sig)) plus offline Ed25519 verify (crypto.verify over kernel canonicalize) with a baked-in public key, entitlements[]+tier+expiry claims, fail-safe-to-community, perpetual-per-major. Only offline verify lives here; issuance is a separate private service.
